plan: Deep-copy the recipe on entry so neither adapt nor print_original can mutate inputs; Fractions are immutable so copies are safe.
Compute a single scale factor target_yield / recipe yield as a Fraction and apply it to every ingredient quantity (main recipe, components, and substitution-introduced ingredients).

Resolve each ingredient independently: while its name is excluded, pick the catalog choice with the lowest (priority, catalog index) key, apply quantity_factor/unit/preparation, record wording changes and equipment additions/removals, and loop on the replacement name so chained substitutions work.

Detect cycles with a per-chain seen set of names; a repeat yields 'substitution cycle involving NAME'. A missing catalog entry yields 'no substitution for NAME'. A replacement that is itself excluded emits a warning and continues the chain.
Recursively resolve additional_ingredients from a choice through the same exclusion/substitution machinery, inheriting the chain's seen set for cycle safety.

Accumulate choices (ordered), warnings (set, sorted at the end), and reasons (set, sorted at the end) in a sink object; never stop at the first failure so all independently applicable reasons are reported.
Give optional components a local sink: if their adaptation fails they are dropped with a warning instead of making the whole adaptation impossible; otherwise their sink merges into the main one.
Finalize equipment as (original union additions) minus removals, sorted; any item not in available_equipment adds 'equipment NAME unavailable'.
Replay recorded wording_changes pairs over every instruction string (main and components) via ordered str.replace to produce final wording.

Return {possible, recipe, choices, warnings, reasons}: on failure recipe is None and reasons is the sorted full list; on success the recipe carries the target yield, scaled quantities, sorted available equipment, rewritten instructions, and empty reasons. print_original returns authored_text unchanged.
mechanisms: Fraction yield-scale factor applied uniformly to all quantities
Deterministic catalog selection by (priority, catalog index) key
Per-ingredient substitution chain loop with seen-set cycle detection
Accumulating sink (choices/warnings/reasons) for exhaustive impossibility reporting
Recursive resolution of additional ingredients under the same exclusions and catalog
Equipment set algebra: union of additions, difference of removals, sorted output, availability check
Ordered wording-change replay over instruction strings
Local sink with drop-and-warn semantics for optional components
Verbatim authored_text passthrough for byte-exact original printing
